headline: Run every tier of the daily huddle from one live board
capabilities: Show every lane, clock and item waiting on the person asking
Draft each escalation with its reason, new clock and pages
Keep mitigated items open until the originator confirms
Bring leadership every decision with its reason and clock
outcomes: Ran every huddle tier from one live board
Escalated unresolved issues faster, with nothing lost
Closed issues only when the fix had truly held
Gave the 10:30 huddle a clear list of decisions
why_try: The demo lets a nurse manager ask between patients what is past target and waiting on her, then draft an escalation that a person confirms, and shows the 10:30 leadership huddle exactly what needs a decision.

sample_prompts.label: Nurse Manager: Whole board view
sample_prompts.prompt: I'm between patients. Show me the huddle board: what's past target and what's waiting on me?

sample_prompts.label: Nurse Manager: Escalation draft
sample_prompts.prompt: 4 West can't fix the IV pump problem at our level. Get the escalation ready for the next tier, but don't page anyone until I confirm.

sample_prompts.label: Nurse Manager: Closure check
sample_prompts.prompt: Biomed fixed the bed alarm in room 412 yesterday. Can we take it off the board?

sample_prompts.label: Chief Nursing Officer: Leadership huddle decisions
sample_prompts.prompt: For the 10:30 leadership huddle, what needs a decision from us today?

business_flow: Nurse managers, department directors and hospital leaders
Microsoft Dataverse huddle board: issues, tiers and clocks
Paging roster by tier and issue category
Authorized escalation and closure step on the Power Apps board
